name: Teaching Agents to Think and Reason
gist: Papers about making agents reason better when using tools — checking their work, thinking before acting, or breaking down problems into smaller pieces.
explain: This cluster focuses on making agents smarter about their decisions before they act. Instead of just immediately calling a tool, they think. They might break a problem into smaller pieces, figure out which pieces matter, reason about dependencies (if I want to answer this, I first need to know that), or double-check their work. Think of it like how a human would solve a hard problem by writing it out, annotating what they know and don't know, and working step by step. The papers here are about teaching agents to do something like that reasoning in code.

The difficulty is that reasoning takes time and thought, but it's not obvious how to make an AI reason in a way that actually helps, because you can break good reasoning by making an agent overthink every tiny choice. Some agents might overthink a simple problem when they should just act. Others might reason in circles, going in loops without making progress, wasting time and compute. Some might reason well on one type of problem but fail to transfer that reasoning to a new situation, so the reasoning isn't generalizable. And there is a fundamental trade-off: more reasoning time means slower answers, which isn't always acceptable in real-time scenarios like driving or helping a user who is waiting. You need the agent to reason *just enough* to avoid mistakes without grinding to a halt.

Papers approach this by teaching agents to recognize when they need to think harder versus when they can act immediately. Some train agents to verify their own answers — after calling a tool, the agent checks whether the result makes sense, which catches mistakes before they propagate. Others teach agents to plan by decomposing a goal into substeps, then execute each step, so the agent doesn't have to keep the whole problem in mind at once. Some focus on teaching agents to recognize their own uncertainty and ask for help or double-check when they're unsure, because acting confidently on a wrong idea is worse than pausing to verify. The underlying goal is to get agents that don't just react, but take a moment to consider what they are doing and why.

papers.title: Agora: Toward Autonomous Bug Detection in Production-Level Consensus Protocols with LLM Agents
papers.contribution: Discovers 15 previously unknown protocol-level logic bugs violating safety properties, while existing LLM agents fail to detect any such bugs.

papers.title: ExVerus: Verus Proof Repair via Counterexample Reasoning
papers.contribution: Significantly improves proof accuracy, robustness, and token efficiency over state-of-the-art prompting-based Verus proof generator.

papers.title: FactGuard: Agentic Video Misinformation Detection via Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both verification accuracy and reliability across three public benchmarks.

papers.title: GLEAN: Guideline-Grounded Evidence Accumulation for High-Stakes Agent Verification
papers.contribution: Surpasses best baseline by 12% in AUROC and 50% in Brier score reduction on agentic clinical diagnosis across three diseases.

papers.title: Grounding Generative Planners in Verifiable Logic: A Hybrid Architecture for Trustworthy Embodied AI
papers.contribution: Achieves perfect 0% Hazardous Action Rate on home safety tasks while completely eliminating unsafe actions through tutor-apprentice dialogue.

papers.title: Hilbert: Recursively Building Formal Proofs with Informal Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves 99.2% on miniF2F (6.6 points above best public method) and 70.0% on PutnamBench (422% improvement over best public baseline), demonstrating best known results.

papers.title: IterResearch: Rethinking Long-Horizon Agents via Markovian State Reconstruction
papers.contribution: The method extends to 2048 interactions with dramatic gains (3.5% to 42.5%) and improves frontier models by up to 19.2pp over ReAct.

papers.title: PaperBanana: Automating Academic Illustration for AI Scientists
papers.contribution: Outperforms baselines on PaperBananaBench (292 NeurIPS cases) in faithfulness, conciseness, readability, and aesthetics.

papers.title: Pessimistic Verification for Open-Ended Math Questions
papers.contribution: Surpasses extended long chain-of-thought and mainstream verification workflows; on IMO 2025 and MathArena Apex 2025 datasets shows remarkable improvements in both efficiency and accuracy on highly challenging contest-level math.

papers.title: VoG: Enhancing LLM Reasoning through Stepwise Verification on Knowledge Graphs
papers.contribution: Consistently improves both reasoning accuracy and efficiency across three benchmark datasets through knowledge graph-augmented iterative verification and revision.

papers.title: Web-CogReasoner: Towards Knowledge-Induced Cognitive Reasoning for Web Agents
papers.contribution: Construct Web-CogDataset from 14 real-world websites with systematic knowledge curation, training Web-CogReasoner agent with significant superiority over existing models.

papers.title: AdaReasoner: Dynamic Tool Orchestration for Iterative Visual Reasoning
papers.contribution: 7B models achieve substantial gains (+38.7% average) and near-perfect accuracy on Visual Spatial Planning (97.6%), surpassing GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4.

papers.title: AnalogVerifier: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Analog Circuit Verification
papers.contribution: AnalogVerifier achieves 82.3%-100% functional pass rate on five industrial analog circuits, establishing new paradigm for end-to-end testbench generation.

papers.title: AutoMoT: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model with Asynchronous Mixture -of-Transformers for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks with reduced inference latency.

papers.title: Autoregressive, Yet Revisable: In Decoding Revision for Secure Code Generation
papers.contribution: Significantly reduces vulnerabilities in secure code generation with minimal inference overhead.

papers.title: Beyond Theorem Proving: Formulation, Framework and Benchmark for Formal Problem-Solving
papers.contribution: Three benchmarks of 1000+ problems showing solving is significantly harder than proving, revealing alignment tax for human-aligned reasoning.

papers.title: Co-RedTeam: Orchestrated Security Discovery and Exploitation with LLM Agents
papers.contribution: Co-RedTeam achieves over 60% success rate in vulnerability exploitation and over 10% absolute improvement in vulnerability detection compared to baselines.

papers.title: CoME: Empowering Channel-of-Mobile-Experts with Informative Hybrid-Capabilities Reasoning
papers.contribution: Outperforms dense agents and MoE methods on AITZ and AMEX; info gain evaluation guides informative reasoning.

papers.title: Context Learning for Multi-Agent Discussion
papers.contribution: M2CL surpasses existing multi-agent discussion methods by 20%-50% and maintains favorable transferability and computational efficiency across reasoning, embodied, and control tasks.

papers.title: CyberJurors: A Multi-Agent Simulation Task for E-Commerce Disputes Verdict
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs, MLLMs, and court simulators while achieving stronger alignment with real-world jury voting patterns.

papers.title: Cycle-of-Science: Reliable Reasoning through Counterfactual Verification for Agent Decision Making
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance through reinforced causal reasoning chains that derive well-validated hypotheses for next agent steps.

papers.title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
papers.contribution: Demonstrates open-ended evolution of self-improving agents that grows an archive of diverse, high-quality agents through Darwinian evolution and validation.

papers.title: Diversity Over Frequency: Rethinking Tool Use in Visual Chain-of-Thought Agents
papers.contribution: Achieves best performance despite declining tool usage by improving exploration diversity.

papers.title: DriveAgent-R1: Advancing VLM-based Autonomous Driving with Active Perception and Hybrid Thinking
papers.contribution: With only 3B parameters, DriveAgent-R1 achieves competitive performance on Drive-Internal and nuScenes comparable to GPT-5 and human driving proficiency through Cascaded RL training.

papers.title: Empowering Efficiency and Efficacy in WebAgent via Enabling Info-Rich Seeking
papers.contribution: Consistently improves both effectiveness and efficiency across five IS benchmarks by retaining accurate and efficient solution trajectories.

papers.title: Error Notebook-Guided, Training-Free Part Retrieval in 3D CAD Assemblies via Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves up to +23.4 absolute accuracy points on human-preference benchmarks for GPT-4o Omni with +4.5 additional points from the grammar verifier across proprietary and open-source VLMs.

papers.title: Escaping Whack-a-Mole: Optimizing Documentation as Repo-Specific Playbooks for Coding Agents
papers.contribution: On DevEval+ with GPT-4o, DocSearch achieves 90.7% solve rate, outperforming the strongest baseline by 32.6%, with documented knowledge transferring effectively across programming languages.

papers.title: FormAct: Agentic Source Editing for Rich-Format Document Generation
papers.contribution: FormAct consistently outperforms baselines including Codex-CLI in generating error-free, professional rich-format documents, with strong improvements on RichDocBench.

papers.title: From Extraction to Deduction: Resolving Functional Misalignment in RAG via a Collaborative Critic-Reasoner Framework
papers.contribution: Achieves 25.99% accuracy gain on conflicting scenarios, resolving the trust bias dilemma in real-world RAG systems.

papers.title: Game-Theoretic Co-Evolution for LLM-Based Heuristic Discovery
papers.contribution: ASRO consistently outperforms static-training baselines across combinatorial optimization domains with substantially improved generalization on diverse and out-of-distribution instances.

papers.title: HVR-Met: A Hypothesis-Verification-Replanning Agentic System for Extreme Weather Diagnosis
papers.contribution: Excels in complex extreme weather diagnostic scenarios.

papers.title: InnoEval: On Research Idea Evaluation as a Knowledge-Grounded, Multi-Perspective Reasoning Problem
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms baselines on point-wise, pair-wise, and group-wise evaluation tasks with judgment patterns and consensus highly aligned with human experts.

papers.title: LLM-Guided Communication for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Improves state reconstruction across agents and yields substantial performance gains over prior communication baselines on diverse MARL benchmarks.

papers.title: Lean Finder: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Understands User Intents
papers.contribution: Achieves over 30% relative improvement compared to previous search engines and GPT-4o; compatible with LLM-based theorem provers.

papers.title: MATA: A Trainable Hierarchical Automaton System for Multi-Agent Visual Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on visual reasoning benchmarks with transparent execution via MATA-SFT-90K dataset for transition policy supervision.

papers.title: Memory is Reconstructed, Not Retrieved: Graph Memory for LLM Agents
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 23% improvement on LoCoMo and LongMemEval benchmarks while substantially reducing retrieval cost.

papers.title: Numina-Lean-Agent: An Open and General Agentic Reasoning System for Formal Mathematics
papers.contribution: Solves all problems in Putnam 2025 (12/12) and successfully formalizes the Brascamp-Lieb theorem.

papers.title: Opt-Verifier: Unleashing the Power of LLMs for Optimization Modeling via Dual-Side Verification
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art with over 20% improvement in modeling accuracy across popular benchmarks.

papers.title: Post-Training LLMs as Better Decision-Making Agents: A Regret-Minimization Approach
papers.contribution: Improves decision-making performance across models including GPT-4o mini with generalization across horizons, action spaces, reward processes, and natural-language scenarios.

papers.title: ProofFlow: A Dependency Graph Approach to Faithful Proof Autoformalization
papers.contribution: Achieves ProofScore of 0.545 on 184 undergraduate-level problems, substantially exceeding baselines like full-proof formalization (0.279) and step-proof formalization (0.046).

papers.title: ReIn: Conversational Error Recovery with Reasoning Inception
papers.contribution: ReIn substantially improves task success and generalizes to unseen error types while outperforming explicit prompt-modification approaches across diverse agent models and inception module combinations.

papers.title: ReVeal: Self-Evolving Code Agents via Reliable Self-Verification
papers.contribution: ReVeal enables code evolution for 20+ turns despite training on three, significantly improving Pass@k on LiveCodeBench.

papers.title: Scaling Agentic Verifier for Competitive Coding
papers.contribution: Achieves 10-15% absolute gains in Best@k accuracy across five competitive programming benchmarks through scalable training combining data synthesis, rejection fine-tuning, and agentic RL.

papers.title: Search-R2: Enhancing Search-Integrated Reasoning via Actor-Refiner Collaboration
papers.contribution: Search-R2 outperforms RAG and RL baselines across QA datasets with superior reasoning accuracy and minimal overhead through hybrid reward design.

papers.title: Seek-CAD: A Self-refined Generative Modeling for 3D Parametric CAD Using Local Inference via DeepSeek
papers.contribution: The paper presents the first exploration of locally deployed reasoning LLMs for CAD generation with a self-refinement mechanism and introduces an SSR-structured CAD model dataset.

papers.title: Skill-Based Mixture-of-Experts: Adaptive Routing for Heterogeneous Reasoning via Inferred Skills
papers.contribution: Achieves 8.15% average absolute improvement on diverse benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, AIME, MedMCQA) while generalizing to unseen tasks, matching 4-GPU baselines on one GPU.

papers.title: Strat-Reasoner: Reinforcing Strategic Reasoning of LLMs in Multi-Agent Games
papers.contribution: Achieves 22.1% average performance improvements across various multi-agent games.

papers.title: TRACER: Trajectory Risk Aggregation for Critical Episodes in Agentic Reasoning
papers.contribution: Improves AUROC by up to 37.1% and AUARC by up to 55% over baselines in predicting task failure and enabling earlier detection of uncertainty.

papers.title: Topology of Reasoning: Retrieved Cell Complex-Augmented Generation for Textual Graph Question Answering
papers.contribution: Consistently surpasses existing methods for textual graph question answering by capturing higher-dimensional topological dependencies.

papers.title: Unified Diffusion VLA: Vision-Language-Action Model via Joint Discrete Diffusion Diffusion Process
papers.contribution: Unified Diffusion VLA achieves state-of-the-art on CALVIN, LIBERO, and SimplerEnv; demonstrates effectiveness through real-world evaluations.

papers.title: WALT: Web Agents that Learn Tools
papers.contribution: WALT achieves significantly higher success rates on VisualWebArena and WebArena with fewer steps and less LLM-dependent reasoning through robust tool-based browser automation.

papers.title: WebShaper: Agentically Data Synthesizing via Information-Seeking Formalization
papers.contribution: WebShaper achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source information-seeking agents on competitive benchmarks through systematic task formalization and multi-step expansion.
